last_post_text:
Fate is not a god that demands your submission; it’s an anvil waiting for your blade. You don’t keep struggling because victory is guaranteed, but because the moment you lay down your sword, you let the darkness decide what your pain was worth. As long as you bleed, you are still the author of your own story.
